about_the_game:
Dive into Psycho Partisans, the gripping episodic adventure horror series!

Survive the brutal grip of an East European dictatorship, blending eerie Slavic mythology with true tales of Belarusian heroes battling for freedom. Each episode unleashes heart-pounding terror and resilience.

Episode1 : Officer 'Nirvana'

Belarus, 2021. After rigged presidential elections, terror grips the nation: police hunt protesters, prisons echo with torture, and streets run red with violence.

Amid the chaos, you are Andrew—a 30-year-old IT programmer seeking escape in a quiet evening of coding. He's building a simple game about the elections to upload online... but nothing stays simple.

What begins as harmless creativity spirals into nightmare. Shadows lurk in the code, the screen whispers secrets, and your digital world bleeds into horrifying reality...

Play Psycho Partisans and…

  • Escape to a beautiful and scary environment of Eastern Europe.

  • Talk to a range of engaging characters, each with their own personalities and stories.

  • Experience pleasant FPS moment where you could finally take revenge on those who occupied your homeland.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows /10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 3 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050ti or AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: Recommend you to use SSD for instant run
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows /10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 or intel core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia geforce gtx 1070 or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: Recommend you to use SSD for instant run
